system.description:
• Trained within Ordenvael, the walled monastic order built for one purpose — hunting down fiends that slip through from the Hells and the Abyss before they can root themselves in Arneyan. Ordenvael doesn't care whose Warlock summoned the thing loose; they just want it gone.
  • Fiend-Marked: Combat Marauder's damage bonus applies to devils, demons, and other fiends in addition to humanoids and giants, and the ranger's weapons count as magical for the purpose of overcoming a fiend's damage resistance.
  • Wardsight: Advantage on checks to detect fiendish corruption, cursed ground, or the residue of a summoning ritual, and advantage on saves vs fear effects created by fiends specifically.
